trends_about: The three trend lanes above the six sectors (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-28: the news shows the big trends in AI and why they are happening, from macroeconomic to behavioural to technical, and the week's ideas follow what is actually happening). Each lane is one British Google News search over the last two days, read outside the creative-sector filter; its stories pass the same writer, fact gate and draft judges as a sector's, and its line of what is moving and why is checked against those stories' own sources. They ride the edition as snapshot.trends, never as items, so a reader that knows only the six sectors still reads the edition.
